integrity: Analytical proof with explicit attaining pairs; exact-rational finite checker is diagnostic, not infinite certification. Originality is qualified by possible earlier equivalent mean-clipping/Gini-variation treatments.
scientific_limitations: Nonnegative real inputs, unweighted complete graphs, counting-measure centered balls, graph total variation of two output differences. The absolute-value signed-input maximal operator has no such seminorm modulus. No assertions on weighted graphs, arbitrary graphs, or all extremizers.
title: Sharp two-input graph-variation modulus of the centered maximal operator on complete graphs
